resolution: BadHeightfields on the /compiled route is fixed and verified. Root cause: a parallel session's in-flight heightfield v2->v3 migration (FORMULAFLOOR-0615, uncommitted in framework/world/constructor.zig) tightened the version-acceptance gate to 'version != 1 and != HEIGHTFIELDS_VERSION(=3)', which rejected v2 — the format worldGeometry.ts still emits — while every v2 decode branch in the body remained intact. Every freshly compiled painted-terrain map hit decodeHeightfields -> Error.BadHeightfields -> construct FAILED, so nothing rendered. Fix: widen the gate to 'version < 1 or version > HEIGHTFIELDS_VERSION' so v1/v2/v3 all decode (the body is already version-gated). Verified: user's editor /compiled route now loads, and a standalone 'rjit game shot' decodes 49 heightfields + 7 terrain meshes GREEN. NOT committed: the one-line fix is entangled in the same file as the parallel session's uncommitted NPC+v3 work, so committing would sweep up their in-flight changes (against 'only commit your own work'); the line needs to land as part of their migration commit or after they commit.
